meta.project: UNI XML & XSLT Canlı Tasarım Editörü

product_overview: A browser-based XML and XSLT invoice editor for designing, previewing, and formatting e-Invoice templates locally. Users can transform XML into live HTML, visually edit invoice layouts, and manage reusable templates without authentication or server-side rendering.
core_goals: Edit XML and XSLT templates in a syntax-highlighted code workspace
Preview XML+XSLT transformations live in the browser
Visually style invoice content through WYSIWYG design tools
Edit text, images, and table layout directly from the preview
Save, load, and reuse XSLT templates locally
Switch themes and print invoice output in A4 format

features.name: Monaco XML/XSLT Editor
features.description: Lets users write and refine XML and XSLT with syntax highlighting, validation, and a split or tabbed workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch between XML and XSLT tabs -> Type code in the editors -> See syntax-highlighted content and inline validation feedback
Navigate to / -> Toggle split/tabbed layout -> Type XML and XSLT content -> Review both code and preview in the chosen workspace layout

features.name: Live XSLT Transformation
features.description: Transforms XML and XSLT locally in the browser and refreshes the HTML preview automatically or on demand.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type XML code in the XML editor -> Type XSLT code in the XSLT editor -> See the live preview update automatically
Navigate to / -> Type XML code in the XML editor -> Type XSLT code in the XSLT editor -> Turn off auto-refresh -> Click Dönüştür -> See the preview refresh manually

features.name: A4 Preview and Zoom Controls
features.description: Displays the transformed invoice output in an A4 preview frame with zoom and fitting controls.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the live preview in the A4 frame -> Adjust zoom using the slider -> See the preview scale change
Navigate to / -> View the live preview in the A4 frame -> Click Zoom In or Zoom Out -> Observe the preview size change
Navigate to / -> View the live preview in the A4 frame -> Toggle Auto Fit -> See the output fit the frame automatically
Navigate to / -> Switch to the HTML output tab -> Review the generated HTML output
Navigate to / -> Switch to the Logs tab -> Review transformation logs

features.name: WYSIWYG Designer Mode
features.description: Allows users to visually style invoice elements directly in the preview and persist those design changes into XSLT.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click an element in the preview -> Adjust font size, color, alignment, spacing, width, wrapping, and border styling -> See the design update in the preview
Navigate to / -> Click an element in the preview -> Toggle bold, italic, or underline -> See the selected text style change
Navigate to / -> Click an element in the preview -> Click İçine Ekle -> Add a new nested element -> See the new element appear in the design
Navigate to / -> Click an element in the preview -> Click Bu Elemanı Sil -> Remove the selected element -> See it disappear from the preview

features.name: Inspector Mode
features.description: Maps preview selections back to their XSLT source so users can jump from rendered output to code.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Turn on Koda Git mode -> Click an element in the preview -> See the XSLT editor jump to the corresponding source line
Navigate to / -> Turn on Koda Git mode -> Click an element in the preview -> Inspect the linked source location in the XSLT editor

features.name: Inline Text Editing
features.description: Lets users edit rendered text directly in the preview and sync the change back into the XSLT source.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Double-click text in the preview -> Type new text inline -> See the updated text reflected in the preview and XSLT code
Navigate to / -> Click Metni Düzenle -> Edit the selected text -> See the text content change in the rendered output

features.name: Image Management
features.description: Supports adding, replacing, resizing, aligning, and removing images used in invoice templates.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Yeni Görsel Ekle -> Add an image file -> See the image appear in the design
Navigate to / -> Click Değiştir -> Replace the selected image -> See the updated image in the preview
Navigate to / -> Adjust image width, alignment, margin, and display or float settings -> See the image layout change
Navigate to / -> Click the trash icon on an image -> Remove the image from the template

features.name: Image Drag and Drop
features.description: Lets users reposition images directly inside the visual preview and then save or reset the pending changes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch to Görsel Düzenleyici tab -> Drag an image to a new position -> Click Değişiklikleri Kaydet -> See the new placement persist
Navigate to / -> Switch to Görsel Düzenleyici tab -> Drag an image to a new position -> Click Sıfırla -> Discard the pending placement change

features.name: Column Resizing
features.description: Enables table column widths to be adjusted by dragging resizer handles in the designer.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter designer mode -> Drag a table column resizer handle -> See the column width update in the preview

features.name: Watermark System
features.description: Adds configurable watermark overlays for invoice designs and lets users save or remove them from the XSLT.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter watermark text -> Select a color -> Upload a watermark image -> Adjust rotation, size, opacity, and visibility -> See the watermark preview update
Navigate to / -> Configure the watermark -> Click XSLT'ye Kaydet -> Persist the watermark into the XSLT
Navigate to / -> Configure the watermark -> Click Kaldır -> Remove the watermark from the XSLT

features.name: Template Library
features.description: Lets users load saved templates and store the current XSLT template to local disk for reuse.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the Şablon Kütüphanesi dropdown -> Select a template -> Load the template into the editor
Navigate to / -> Type a template name -> Click Şablonlara Kaydet -> Save the current template locally
Navigate to / -> Click the refresh control in the template library -> Reload the available template list

features.name: Auto-Updater
features.description: Provides a manual way to check for application updates and trigger the update flow when available.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Şimdi Denetle -> Check whether an update is available
Navigate to / -> Use the update notification control when shown -> Trigger the update flow

features.name: Theme Switcher
features.description: Allows users to switch the interface between multiple visual themes instantly.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click one of the theme color controls -> See the entire interface change theme instantly

features.name: File Upload and Output Download
features.description: Supports importing XML or XSLT files and exporting the generated output for printing, copying, or downloading.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click XML Yükle -> Upload an XML file -> See the XML content load into the editor
Navigate to / -> Click XSLT Yükle -> Upload an XSLT file -> See the XSLT content load into the editor
Navigate to / -> Drag and drop XML or XSLT files onto the workspace -> See the files load into the editors
Navigate to / -> Click HTML Kopyala -> Copy the generated HTML output
Navigate to / -> Click Dosya İndir -> Download the current file output
Navigate to / -> Click Yazdır/PDF -> Open the print dialog with A4-formatted output

features.name: Embedded XSLT Detection
features.description: Detects embedded base64-encoded XSLT inside XML and gives users control over whether to load, ignore, or remove it.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Load XML that contains embedded XSLT -> See the detection prompt appear -> Click Tasarımı Şablona Yükle -> Load the embedded design
Navigate to / -> Load XML that contains embedded XSLT -> See the detection prompt appear -> Click Yoksay -> Continue without loading it
Navigate to / -> Load XML that contains embedded XSLT -> See the detection prompt appear -> Click XML'den Kaldır -> Remove the embedded XSLT from the XML

features.name: Quick Jump Navigation
features.description: Provides shortcut buttons for jumping to major sections of the XSLT code.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click CSS -> Jump to the CSS section in the XSLT code
Navigate to / -> Click Satıcı -> Jump to the supplier section in the XSLT code
Navigate to / -> Click Alıcı -> Jump to the customer section in the XSLT code
Navigate to / -> Click Fatura No -> Jump to the invoice number section in the XSLT code
Navigate to / -> Click Ürünler -> Jump to the items section in the XSLT code
Navigate to / -> Click Toplamlar -> Jump to the totals section in the XSLT code

features.name: Print Support
features.description: Formats the invoice output for printing in an A4-friendly layout.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Yazdır/PDF -> Open the print dialog with clean A4 print styling

features.name: Status Panel
features.description: Shows validation, file size, template, and update status information for the current workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View XML validation status -> View XSLT validation status -> Review file sizes and the saved template list
Navigate to / -> View the status panel -> See whether an update is available

known_limitations.issue: All data held in Zustand (in-memory). Page refresh loses unsaved work.
known_limitations.impact: User must save templates before refresh

known_limitations.issue: Zustand selectedElement may be stale compared to App.tsx local state
known_limitations.impact: Dual state management can cause selection inconsistencies

known_limitations.issue: Watermark preview-only until user clicks XSLT'ye Kaydet
Image transforms pending until Değişiklikleri Kaydet

known_limitations.impact: Changes cannot be reverted without manual editing

known_limitations.issue: EditorToolbar and EditorPanel components may not be fully wired
known_limitations.impact: Modular components exist but App.tsx inlines UI directly

known_limitations.issue: Auto-updater requires git remote to work
known_limitations.impact: Silently reports no update if git not configured

known_limitations.issue: data-xslt-id is ephemeral - regenerated each render
